name: io.github.JacekSmi/PolishOpenData
title: Polish Open Data (unofficial)
description: Polish registers: KRS, VAT, bank checks, parcels, geocoding (GUGiK), optional REGON, ID validation.

environmentVariables.name: POLISHOPENDATA_OFFLINE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the prepared VAT whitelist flat-file indexes used by check_vat_bank_account_offline (a local disk, not a network share). Default: PolishOpenData/BialaListaOffline under the user's local application data folder.

environmentVariables.name: POLISHOPENDATA_REGON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own free GUS BIR key (regon_bir@stat.gov.pl); enables the lookup_regon tool. Stays on your machine.
